scope: Official public documentation sample; broad feature-family coverage, not exhaustive article crawl or live product audit.

families.title: Shell, navigation and discovery
families.documented: Persistent rail and contextual panels; preview of collapsed panel by hover; pin Recents on page or everywhere; filtered sections; library by asset type; optional page navigation in sidebar. Keep layout revisions distinct.
families.validation_pending: Capture rail, sidebar, preview, pin/unpin, scroll, search, keyboard focus, touch alternative, back/forward and tab persistence.

families.title: Views, query and visualization
families.documented: One collection projected into multiple views. Gallery adds responsive cards, three card sizes, optional covers, field ordering, one group dimension (no subgroup), field/operator/value filtering, shared save vs autosave vs revert; view menu pin, private, protect, default, duplicate, move and delete. Table offers spreadsheet-like editing; Board changes grouping property via drag; distinguish task views from page content and legacy Chat view.
families.validation_pending: Validate each view, grouping/filter semantics, multi-select, drag/keyboard equivalence, large collections, empty/loading/error, personal/shared persistence, overflow menu and permission restrictions.

families.title: Objects, properties, relationships and bulk operations
families.documented: Hierarchy: Workspace > Space > Folder/Subfolder > List > task/subtask, with multiple-list projection where enabled. Typed fields scoped by type and location; collapsible sections; relationships and dependencies; comments/activity separate; open full screen, modal, sidebar; preference reused. Bulk selection changes status, fields, links or location subject to permission.
families.validation_pending: Verify focus restoration, editing conflicts, pending/rollback, no relationship state, validation, field conversion warnings, type change, deletion and selection scope.

families.title: Docs, wiki, rich text and knowledge
families.documented: Nested document pages, content blocks, wikis, style controls, task creation from text, slash commands, hub, bulk actions and linked knowledge. Export formats are documented, not fidelity tested.
families.validation_pending: Capture selection toolbar, slash menu, nested page tree, block movement, undo, link navigation, editor keyboard/clipboard, collaboration and export fidelity.

families.title: Whiteboards, forms and sheets
families.documented: Canvas main toolbar plus selection toolbar; form builder separates creation from submission, maps fields into tasks; Sheets add spreadsheet objects distinct from Table views (formulas, charts, conditional formatting).
families.validation_pending: Verify zoom/pan, object selection, keyboard, pointer and touch, undo, form preview/validation/submission/retry, Sheets formula errors and range selection.

families.title: Dashboard, reporting, time and planning
families.documented: Composable dashboards, card data contracts, chart drilldown, auto-layout, timeline capacity, tracked/estimated time, planner and calendar sync. Distinguish aggregate chart from its source records.
families.validation_pending: Validate filter scope, date/time zone, empty/zero/loading/error, stale data, drilldown consistency, accessible chart tables and export.

families.title: Collaboration, inbox, sharing and lifecycle
families.documented: Inbox and notifications, chat, comments, sharing by resource and role, restore lifecycle, activity/audit history. Permission gating is distinct from visibility and actual access enforcement.
families.validation_pending: Verify notification read/snooze behavior, deep links, conflict states, invite/role changes, private content access, recovery, keyboard and destructive-action handling.

families.title: Brain, agents, artifacts and creative tools
families.documented: Manual mention/DM/assignment, schedule or automation triggers; per-trigger prompt; skills, tool access, recent/preference/intelligence memory modes as documented; preference memory approval; personal app knowledge may expose data to agent users. Artifact creation from chat and templates; Labs AI Drive and beta Agent Workflows must remain explicitly flagged. Creative Studio editor and export.
families.validation_pending: Capture agent builder, tool grants, schedule, logs, cancel/retry, artifact preview/editor/revision, execution sandbox, errors and approval behavior. No runtime security or memory-capacity claim.

families.title: Platforms, accessibility and integration
families.documented: Web, desktop and mobile differ; high-contrast preference and documented shortcuts do not establish WCAG compliance. Mobile task tabs differ from browser tabs; test in-app open-object history separately.
families.validation_pending: Capture breakpoints, zoom, reduced motion, focus order, screen reader names, keyboard traps, touch, offline/reconnect and internationalization.

families.title: Integrations, API and MCP
families.documented: Public API and webhook subscriptions, OAuth and token authentication, rate limits per token; directory includes MCP and app integrations. No live API calls or endpoint-by-endpoint extraction.
families.validation_pending: Verify API schemas/version, permissions, retries, idempotency, rate limits, webhook signatures and exact MCP capabilities before implementation.
